node: Power conversion, transformers, switchgear, HVDC, and power quality equipment
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the power-conversion-equipment node found one obvious reference leader and three underfollowed or less-obvious US-listed candidates. The strongest direct small/mid-cap match is Powell Industries, which supplies engineered electrical-energy distribution and medium-voltage switchgear and has explicitly tied opportunities to data-center and AI power demand. nVent is a larger but still less-discussed electrical connection/protection platform whose Avail Electrical Products Group acquisition added switchgear, bus systems, and power-utility/data-center infrastructure exposure. Preformed Line Products is not a transformer or switchgear maker, but it is a low-attention second-order grid hardware candidate tied to transmission and distribution construction. Hubbell is included as the reference leader for utility T&D, substation, connectors, grid protection, and electrical infrastructure context.
